initiatives.name: Soda City Abortion Access Collective
initiatives.description: Black, queer, trans and disability-centered reproductive mutual aid group in Columbia, SC. Offers abortion and reproductive justice support through an intake form and volunteers.

initiatives.name: Really Free Cola
initiatives.description: Monthly free market in Columbia, SC, held the third Saturday at MLK Jr. Park, where people bring items to give away and take what they need.

initiatives.name: Columbia Medic Collective
initiatives.description: Street medic collective in Columbia that runs monthly free health supply distributions and offers street medic and opsec trainings.
